purpose: Public native GraphCoder JSON-lines qualification over a durable local Harness

runtime.fixture_policy: The stage model is an explicit deterministic fixture. Its transcript proves runtime routing, durable operation identity, reopen, and staged file reads; it does not prove model quality or a production provider.

fault_boundary: The first start response is discarded after durable execution. A fresh runtime process retries the same operation identity before reading the staged file and reopening the session.
assertions: the native executable is an explicit regular-file artifact
the child process receives only the minimal platform environment
list_sessions returns a typed collection and an unsupported model fixture is rejected as invalid_input
the first start request is interrupted while its response is suppressed rather than synchronously consumed
every response is correlated to the exact request identifier that caused it
the retry reuses the original operation identity
the staged file has the exact fixture bytes and media type
the installed createNodeGraphCoderConnection transport decodes readFile with a nonzero BigInt generation
the installed terminal export drives open, activity, and file through the same native JSON-lines bridge and validates typed projections
installed consumer requests have bounded deadlines and the bridge process exit is observed before cleanup
reopen returns the completed durable session
activity is loaded through its own public route
a nonzero process exit or malformed response fails the lane

evidence.artifact_binding: The suite descriptor must include the exact native executable digest, installed package archive and manifest digests, suite descriptor digest, qualified source commit/tree, build ID, build timestamp, and unchanged post-run digest.
evidence.fixture_boundary: This scenario may support a native fixture checkpoint, but it cannot satisfy production model or full GraphCoder terminal package rows.
